content.short: 4.444 algorithmically created Dino NFTs on the Cardano blockchain to Collect, Trade and Show off!
content.description: Cardino's were born from a late night conversation about how simply awesome Dinosaurs and NFT's are. Since then we have worked tirelessly to create 10,000 of the coolest looking unique Dinosaur NFT's on the ADA (Cardano) blockchain for you. Our Dino NFT's are online trading cards. Every dino NFT is unique with a different rarity. Who will be the first to collect all our different varieties of dinosaurs? Not just 1 series of Cardinos! We have special editions for the Skydinos as well as Seadinos before the Apocalypse hits! Cardino's were born from a late night.
